name: Unmatched Canonical Topology Change Requires Review
sourceDocument: PROJECT-DEFINED SAFETY CONTROL — not an RBI requirement
clauseText: A material canonical financial-topology change cannot silently pass. When the graph delta is non-empty and no more specific policy explains it, human review is required.
observableGraphCondition: GraphDelta is non-empty and no specific policy or evidence safeguard has produced a finding.
implementationNotes: This is a project-defined release safety rule, not an RBI clause or legal-compliance determination.
Specific BLOCK and REVIEW findings take precedence and suppress this generic finding.
Canonicalization excludes labels, provenance, source locations, evidence IDs, and trust metadata from topology identity.
